## What changed

Describe the behavior or product change in concrete terms.

## Why

Explain the user problem or architectural reason.

## Validation

- [ ] Typecheck passes
- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] Desktop frontend builds
- [ ] UI was checked at narrow and wide window sizes
- [ ] Registry changes include an official source and verification date

## Design check

- [ ] No decorative separators or badge walls
- [ ] No unnecessary headings, cards, or controls
- [ ] Spacing and typography carry the hierarchy
- [ ] Copy is direct and free of generated filler
